headline: Celtics look to keep Garden momentum alive against visiting Milwaukee Bucks
morning_brew: No baseball or football last night, so I spent the evening staring at the wall and wondering if the C's are ready for this tilt against Milwaukee. We are back at the Garden tonight, and after that absolute disaster in Houston, this team needs a statement performance to prove they actually belong near the top of the conference. The Bucks are struggling, but you can never sleep on them, and I'll be expecting Jayson Tatum and Derrick White to stop messin' around and set the tone from the opening tip.

Looking at the rest of the schedule, it is a busy week for Boston sports fans. The Bruins are shipping up to Pittsburgh tomorrow to keep their momentum rolling, and the Patriots have a massive matchup with Green Bay waiting on Sunday. It feels like the season is finally finding its rhythm, and while my blood pressure takes a hit every time we play a nail-biter, I am already dreaming of the Pats getting back to Gillette to defend our home turf.

Tonight's game is gonna be the perfect test to see if our perimeter defense can actually hold up against a team that needs a win as bad as I need to forget that last road trip. I have my lucky jersey ready and a fresh coffee in hand, so I am hoping for a clean, dominant showing. If the C's can protect the parquet and keep the ball moving, we will be in good shape, but either way, I am just happy to have a game on the tube tonight.

news_digest.headline: Boston faces Milwaukee, looks for 5th straight home win
news_digest.dans_take: Five straight at home would be a nice way to wash the bitter taste of that Houston game out of my mouth.
